$comment: Page types, domains and mood words used by scripts/compose.mjs. Every id must exist in catalog.json (checked by tests/unit/compose.test.mjs).

pageTypes.name: Product landing page
pageTypes.layout: Centred page column with full-width bands
pageTypes.primary: Under the hero headline, and again in the closing CTA band. Nowhere else.

sections.copy: Brand left, 3–5 links, one CTA right ("Start free").
sections.rule: Use navbar-simple instead when there is only one product area. Its button is secondary (or a text link) when the hero carries the primary.

sections.copy: Eyebrow (≤4 words) → headline that says the outcome (≤10 words) → one sentence of how → one CTA + one quiet link → one reassurance line ("No card required"). The headline is the page’s h1.
sections.rule: Show the real product on the right, not an illustration.

sections.copy: "Used by teams at" + 5–6 names.
sections.rule: Only with real customers; skip it rather than invent logos.

sections.copy: 2–3 rows. Each: a heading that states a result, one sentence, 2–3 specific points, a real screenshot or a small live mockup built from catalog parts (stat-strip, data-table, a chart) inside a frame marked data-mock. Never a grey box or stock art.
sections.rule: Alternate image left/right. Never more than three rows.

sections.copy: 3 numbers people can check, each with a plain label and a source.
sections.rule: No vanity totals; one figure per claim.

sections.copy: 3 quotes with name, role and company; each quote names a concrete result.
sections.rule: Only real quotes you may use, with name, role and company. Without them, show a fact strip people can check (customers, uptime, years) or skip the section. Never invent people.

sections.copy: 3 steps, verb-first headings ("Connect", "Set targets", "Share").
5–7 questions buyers actually ask: price, data, switching, security, cancelling.
Restate the outcome in one line + the same CTA as the hero.
sections.rule: Same label as the hero button.

sections.copy: 3–4 columns of 3–5 links, one line about the company, one legal row.

pageTypes.name: Pricing page
pageTypes.layout: Centred page column with full-width bands
pageTypes.primary: The recommended tier's button is the only filled one.

sections.copy: Same as the rest of the site.
sections.rule: Its button is secondary (or a text link) when the hero carries the primary.

sections.copy: Headline that answers "what will this cost me" + monthly/annual toggle with the saving in plain numbers ("2 months free").
3 tiers. Each: who it is for (one line), price, the 4–6 things that differ, one button. Mark one as recommended.
sections.rule: Never four or more tiers above the fold.

sections.copy: Grouped rows; ticks and short values, not paragraphs.
sections.rule: Sticky header row.

sections.copy: Trials, seats, invoices, cancelling, discounts.
"Still deciding?" + talk to sales as the secondary action.

avoid: Hidden prices ("Contact us" on every tier)
Feature lists that repeat across tiers

pageTypes.name: Analytics dashboard
pageTypes.layout: App shell: sidebar + scrolling main; KPI row then a two-up chart grid
pageTypes.primary: Top right of the page header ("Export", "New report").

sections.copy: 5–9 sections, icons + labels, current one marked.
Title (what this page answers) + "updated 2 minutes ago" + one action.
Date range, segment, compare. One bar for the whole page.
sections.rule: Cards never repeat these filters.

sections.copy: 2–4 figures, each with a label, a change vs the last period and a sparkline.
sections.rule: The most important figure first.

sections.copy: Each chart title is the takeaway ("Team plan pulled ahead in March"), subtitle is the measure and unit.
sections.rule: The widest story spans both columns. Pick charts from references/chart-selection.md.

sections.copy: Sortable, numbers right-aligned and tabular, one row action menu.

states: loading: skeleton of the same layout
empty: say what will appear and give one action
error: what failed, a retry button, keep the filters
avoid: A filter bar inside every card

pageTypes.name: Settings and account
pageTypes.layout: Settings: section nav + one form column (max 420px)
pageTypes.primary: A sticky save bar that appears only after a change; switches save instantly.

sections.copy: General, Members, Billing, API, Notifications, Danger zone.
Name, URL, time zone. One column, labels above fields.
Switches that apply immediately, each with one line of description.
Invite by email, role per row, remove.
Current plan, next invoice, payment method; usage below it.
Each limit as a meter with used / limit.
Masked key, copy, roll with a second confirm.
Last on the page. Type the name to confirm.
"You have unsaved changes" + Discard + Save. Copy the save bar from the settings blueprint (#savebar); the sticky-action-bar component is a purchase bar.
sections.rule: Only for fields that do not save instantly.

states: saving: button shows progress
error: inline under the field, never only a toast

pageTypes.name: Documentation
pageTypes.layout: Three columns: tree nav, article at 68ch, "On this page" rail
pageTypes.primary: None in the article; the top bar holds search and one CTA ("Get API key").

sections.copy: Logo, product switcher, ⌘K search, one CTA.
Grouped by task, not by internal module names.
Title = the task ("Send your first event"). Short intro, then numbered steps.
sections.rule: Text never wider than 68ch.

sections.copy: Tabs per language, copy button, real values.
Only for warnings and prerequisites.
sections.rule: Max two per page.

sections.copy: Previous and next, each naming the page it opens.

states: not found: search box plus the 5 most visited pages

pageTypes.name: Sign in and onboarding
pageTypes.layout: Split: form left (max 400px), product image or quote right; stacks on phones
pageTypes.primary: One full-width button in the form.

sections.copy: Heading says where you are ("Sign in to Halyard"). Email first, SSO as secondary.
6 boxes, paste fills all, resend after 30s.
3–4 steps max, each with one question.
3–5 tasks with progress.

states: error: under the field, keep what was typed
loading: button shows progress, form stays visible
avoid: Password rules revealed only after failing

pageTypes.name: Directory or catalogue
pageTypes.layout: Search on top, filters left or as chips, card grid that never needs a breakpoint
pageTypes.primary: Search is the main control; each card has one action.

sections.copy: Placeholder names what you can search ("Search 240 integrations").
4–8 chips, counts on each, clear all.
Same card height, name, one-line summary, 1–2 facts.
Show the total.
Say what was searched, offer to clear filters.

states: empty: suggest a broader search
loading: skeleton cards

pageTypes.name: Blog or editorial
pageTypes.layout: Single column at 68ch; images may break out wider
pageTypes.primary: Subscribe, once, after the article.

sections.copy: Name in the middle, sections left, subscribe right.
Headline that says the point, standfirst, byline + date + read time.
3 related pieces with dates.
What arrives and how often ("One email a month").

avoid: Share bars that follow the text

pageTypes.name: Portfolio or studio site
pageTypes.layout: Centred page column; work in a two-up grid
pageTypes.primary: "Get in touch" in the top bar and at the end.

sections.copy: Name, Work, About, Contact.
One sentence about what you make and for whom. The headline is the page’s h1.
sections.rule: Drop the announcement pill and the product mockup: a portfolio hero is the statement and one link.

sections.copy: 4–6 projects as large plates: name, type and place, year. Put a real photo or drawing in each plate; without images every plate keeps the same numbered style.
2–3 short quotes.
sections.rule: Only real quotes you may use, with name, role and company. Without them, show a fact strip people can check (customers, uptime, years) or skip the section. Never invent people.

sections.copy: Email, availability, what to include.

pageTypes.name: Store product page
pageTypes.layout: Split: gallery left (60%), buy box right (40%); buy box sticks on desktop
pageTypes.primary: "Add to bag" in the buy box; on phones a sticky bar repeats it.

sections.copy: Brand centred, categories left, search + bag right.
sections.rule: Its button is secondary (or a text link) when the hero carries the primary.

sections.copy: 4–6 photos with thumbnails that switch the main view (the store blueprint’s .sp-gallery), zoom on click.
h1 name, tasting or key facts, price (was/now only if real), options as segmented control and chips, one-off vs subscription as radio cards, delivery date, Add to bag with the total on the button.
Average, count, distribution, 3 recent reviews.
Materials, sizing, delivery and returns.
Price + Add to bag.
sections.rule: Phones only.

sections.copy: 4–8 items, never required to buy.

states: out of stock: say when it is back, offer a notify button

pageTypes.name: Checkout
pageTypes.layout: Split: form left (max 560px), order summary right; summary moves on top on phones
pageTypes.primary: One "Pay £X" button whose label includes the total.

sections.copy: Brand only, no navigation, a "Secure checkout" line.
sections.rule: Remove every link that leaves the flow.

sections.copy: Contact → Delivery → Payment.
Email first; postcode lookup; one column.
2–3 options with date and price.
Items, promo code, subtotal, delivery, tax, total.

states: error: under the field and summarised at the top
processing: disable the button, show progress, never double-charge
avoid: Surprise fees on the last step

pageTypes.name: Changelog
pageTypes.layout: Single column at 68ch with dates in a left gutter on desktop
pageTypes.primary: Subscribe to updates (RSS or email) in the header.

sections.copy: Date, version, a title that says what changed, 1–3 sentences, an image if visual.
sections.rule: Newest first.

sections.copy: New, Improved, Fixed. One per entry.
"Get one email when we ship something."

pageTypes.name: Status page
pageTypes.layout: Centred column (max 760px)
pageTypes.primary: Subscribe to updates.

sections.copy: One line: "All systems working" or what is affected, with the time.
sections.rule: Colour plus an icon plus words, never colour alone.

sections.copy: One row per service, 90 days, % uptime.
Past incidents: what broke, impact, fix, times in UTC.
Email or RSS.

states: incident: the banner changes tone and links to the live update

pageTypes.name: Admin list (users, orders, records)
pageTypes.layout: App shell; page header, one filter row, full-width table
pageTypes.primary: "Invite user" / "New order" top right; bulk actions appear when rows are ticked.

sections.copy: Title + count ("Users · 1,284") + one action.
Search, 2–3 filters, saved views.
Checkbox column, sortable headers, status badges, row menu.
Appears when rows are ticked: count + 2–3 actions.
Rows per page and total.
Opens beside the table so the list stays visible.

states: empty: explain and offer the main action
loading: skeleton rows
error: keep filters, offer retry
avoid: Edit forms in modals for long records

pageTypes.name: AI assistant chat
pageTypes.layout: History rail left (a drawer on phones), one reading column for the conversation (max 760px), composer pinned to the bottom
pageTypes.primary: Send, in the composer. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.

sections.copy: "New chat" on top, then conversations grouped by Today, Yesterday, Earlier, titled by their first question.
sections.rule: On phones it becomes a drawer behind a menu button, never a column of unlabelled icons.

sections.copy: The person's turn in a soft bubble on the right; the assistant's answer as plain prose on the left with its actions (Copy, Retry) underneath.
sections.rule: Answers are text first: headings, lists, tables and code blocks render properly; never one wall of text in a bubble.

sections.copy: A placeholder that says what to ask ("Ask about your revenue…"), attach, model or mode picker only if it matters, Send.
sections.rule: Pinned to the bottom; grows to 6 lines; Stop replaces Send while an answer streams.

sections.copy: One line about what it can do and 3–4 example prompts as buttons that fill the composer.
sections.rule: No mascot, no sparkle icons, no gradient orb.

states: empty: example prompts
streaming: text appears with a caret and a Stop button
error: say what failed under the turn and offer Retry; keep the question
avoid: Purple gradients and sparkle icons to signal AI
Read receipts and typing avatars from messaging apps
A disclaimer longer than the answer

pageTypes.name: Inbox or team chat
pageTypes.layout: Three panes: folders, list, reading pane; collapses to one pane on phones
pageTypes.primary: "New message" top of the list pane.

sections.copy: Resizable list and reading pane.
Sender, subject, snippet, time; unread in bold.
Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line.

states: empty folder: one calm line
offline: banner and queued messages

pageTypes.name: 404 and error page
pageTypes.layout: One centred block
pageTypes.primary: "Go to home" or search.

sections.copy: Say what happened, why it might have happened, where to go next.
sections.rule: No jokes at the visitor's expense.

avoid: Animated illustrations that delay the message

pageTypes.name: Contact page
pageTypes.layout: Split: form left, ways to reach you right
pageTypes.primary: Send in the form.

sections.rule: Its button is secondary (or a text link) when the hero carries the primary.

sections.copy: Reply time, email, office hours.
Top 4 questions.

states: sent: confirm and say when you will reply

pageTypes.name: About and team page
pageTypes.layout: Centred page column with full-width bands
pageTypes.primary: "See open roles" or "Contact us".

sections.rule: Its button is secondary (or a text link) when the hero carries the primary.

sections.copy: One sentence of what you do and for whom; skip the mission statement. The headline is the page’s h1.
Founded, team size, customers.
Photo, name, role, one line.
Open roles or contact.

pageTypes.name: Developer tool landing page
pageTypes.layout: Centred page column with full-width bands; a floating pill nav over a hero with a grid backdrop
pageTypes.primary: Under the hero headline ("Get an API key" or "Read the docs"), with the install command beside it. Again in the closing band.

sections.copy: Brand, Docs, API, Pricing, Changelog, Sign in, one primary button.
sections.rule: data-variant="pill" floats it over the hero. Docs is always one click away.

sections.copy: Headline: what it does for the code, in under 8 words ("Product events, from one line of code"). Lede: the mechanism and one number. An announcement-pill above for what shipped last.
sections.rule: One primary button and a command-chip with the real install command. data-backdrop="grid spot"; add backdrop-circuit only here.

sections.copy: Three numbered steps beside a terminal that runs the real setup commands and shows their real output.
sections.rule: Six to ten lines. It plays once; never loop it.

sections.copy: The smallest complete example, with tabs for each language you support and a file name.
sections.rule: 8 to 14 lines that would run if pasted. No pseudo-code, no ellipses.

sections.copy: Six things the reader no longer has to build, each a 3–5 word heading and one sentence with a number or a limit.
sections.rule: No adjectives without a figure. Same icon style throughout.

sections.copy: Three real endpoints as rows, the first open with its parameters and a sample response; a link to the full reference.
sections.rule: Method as a word in a tag, path in mono. Skip this section if there is no public API.

sections.copy: Four operational figures with their period: volume, latency, uptime, losses.
sections.rule: Units written out; no rounded vanity numbers.

sections.copy: One engineer, by name and company, saying what they removed or stopped doing, with two or three figures beside it.
sections.rule: One quote, not a wall of logos.

sections.copy: The same action as the hero, plus the free tier and the price after it in one line.
sections.rule: One primary, one ghost link to the docs.

sections.copy: Company, Privacy, Terms, Status, Contact.
sections.rule: Status links to the real status page.

avoid: A dashboard screenshot where code should be
Animated gradient blobs and glowing orbs
Code samples that would not run
Counting GitHub stars as proof when there are few
A second moving background below the hero

pageTypes.name: Agent workspace
pageTypes.layout: Sidebar (workspace switcher, sessions by project, account) and a main pane: a centred start column at rest, a reading column for a running session
pageTypes.primary: Start, in the composer. While a session runs, the one primary is the approval it is waiting for.

sections.copy: The current account and workspace; a grouped menu to change it, with a dot where work is running.
sections.rule: Top of the sidebar. Names, not avatars alone.

sections.copy: "New session" first, then sessions grouped by project, each titled by its task with a state and a time.
sections.rule: State is a shape and a word for screen readers: running, needs you, done, idle. A drawer on phones.

sections.copy: A headline that asks for the task, the composer with a placeholder that names three kinds of input, and a mode switch only if modes differ in what they can change.
sections.rule: Under it, say what the session will use and what it is allowed to do (folder, branch, "asks before it edits").

sections.copy: A quiet dither field behind the start screen only.
sections.rule: Lower its colour until the headline reads on it without a shadow. Never behind a running session.

sections.copy: Three or four recent sessions as rows: title, project, state in words, time.
sections.rule: The whole row is the link.

sections.copy: In a running session: the plan as a checked list, then the change it wants to make.
sections.rule: Nothing is written until the person approves. The approval bar says how many files and stays in view.

states: empty: no sessions yet, with four first tasks that fill the composer
running: plan with one step in progress, the proposed change, an approval bar
error: say which step failed and why; offer Retry from that step
avoid: Sparkle icons, orbs and purple gradients to signal AI
A chat transcript where a plan and a diff would be clearer
Hiding what the agent can touch
Auto-applying changes with no way to stop or review
A loud backdrop behind text people have to read

pageTypes.name: Phone app screen
pageTypes.layout: One 430px column: app bar, content, one primary action in thumb reach, bottom tabs. Stays a centred column on wider screens.
pageTypes.primary: One full-width button above the tab bar. Everything else is a row or a tab.

sections.copy: The screen's name as a large title; back with the previous screen's name on inner screens; at most one text action.
sections.rule: The large title collapses into the bar on scroll. 44px targets.

sections.copy: The one number the person opened the app for, a comparison in words, and a small 7-day view.
sections.rule: One figure, not a dashboard. Tabular numbers.

sections.copy: Two short lists with headings: what needs attention first, then recent history. Name and amount on the first line, detail and status on the second.
sections.rule: Whole-row targets at least 56px tall. Status is a word in a badge, not a colour alone.

sections.copy: Three to five destinations with an icon and a label each.
sections.rule: Labels always visible. A count only where something needs attention.

sections.copy: The primary action opens a sheet with the fewest fields that can work: amount, who, when, send.
sections.rule: Right keyboard for each field (inputmode). Errors in words under the field. Cancel always visible.

states: loading: skeleton of the figure and five rows
empty: one sentence and the primary action
error: what failed and a Retry button, keeping anything typed
avoid: A hamburger menu hiding the main destinations
Desktop tables squeezed onto a phone
More than one filled button on a screen
Stretching the layout full width on a tablet

notes: Keep every piece of content, every link and every form field. Change how it looks, not what it says.
Add lumina.css and lumina.js (or the tokens) and the <html> data attributes from the install output; delete the old colours, gradients and shadows instead of overriding them.
Map each existing section onto the closest block below and copy its words in. Sections with no match keep their markup and get .lt-band and .lt-container.
One primary button per screen: keep every action, but make the others secondary or ghost.
Replace emoji used as icons with inline SVG icons; replace purple or rainbow gradients with a flat surface.
Every link must go somewhere: point in-page links (#pricing) at real ids, or turn them into plain text.
Run the audit on the old page first, then on yours, and say how the score changed.

directions.$comment: Three distinct looks per domain, used by scripts/directions.mjs and the composer's questions. First = the expected one.
